Container.Name: ReelIndex
Container.Overview:
ReelIndex is a read-only movie inventory application with poster and table views, title search, ffprobe technical metadata, incremental scans, Plex/Jellyfin/Emby adapters, scheduled rescans, and cached artwork.
This local template expects the reelindex:unraid image to be built first using the included install-reelindex.sh script.
Container.Requires: Build the local image before creating the container. Run unraid/install-reelindex.sh from the extracted project directory. Media paths must be mounted read-only. In ReelIndex, use the container path /media rather than the Unraid host path.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port used to open the ReelIndex web interface.

Config.Name: Application Data
Config.Description: SQLite database, encrypted source credentials, poster cache, and application state.

Config.Name: Movie Library
Config.Description: Primary movie library. This mapping is intentionally read-only. Configure filesystem sources in ReelIndex using /media.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone used by the container.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID used for writable application data. Unraid default is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID used for application data and media reads. Unraid default is 100 (users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation mask for ReelIndex data.

Config.Name: Demo Mode
Config.Description: Set to true only to seed a synthetic demonstration library.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Python application logging level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR.

Config.Name: TMDB API Token
Config.Description: Optional TMDB bearer token used as a poster and descriptive metadata fallback.

Config.Name: ffprobe Timeout
Config.Description: Maximum number of seconds allowed for each ffprobe operation.

Config.Name: Allowed Extensions
Config.Description: Comma-separated video file extensions included in filesystem scans.
